avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 induction reduces olanzapine levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support supplements if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk; additive CNS depression and sedation
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to discontinue before olanzapine initiation

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase olanzapine levels and adverse effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased sedation, orthostasis, or metabolic effects; limit consumption

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; advise patient to monitor for excessive drowsiness

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.action: Monitor dosing and timing; patient may require dose adjustment of either agent

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases olanzapine bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet during olanzapine therapy

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase olanzapine absorption and peak levels, potentially enhancing side effects
caution_foods.action: Advise consistent meal timing and fat intake; take consistently with or without food

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP1A2 competition; high intake may increase olanzapine levels; stimulant effects may counteract sedation
caution_foods.action: Limit caffeine intake; counsel on moderate consumption to avoid interaction

monitoring_notes: Monitor for metabolic effects (weight gain, glucose dysregulation, lipid changes), orthostatic hypotension, and excessive CNS depression. Assess adherence and efficacy, as supplement interactions may reduce therapeutic benefit or increase adverse effects requiring dose adjustment.
